item.tib: rig 'dzin yab sras rnam gsum thugs sgrubs las dbal mo'i gtor bskul
item.coloph: ces par gyim shod shel brag tu sa phag zla ba'i tshes la tshogs gral nas rgyud lung brtsal bzhin lo dus kyi bka' rgya yol mtshams la slar mad+hal ri khrod du shing sbrul zla 10tshes 9la tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen po'i (pos) lo chen gyi brda yig gnang ba la kho bo g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis tshes 10 kyi nyi shar bod yig du (tu) phab pa'o bkra shis so
item.margin: ye shes dbal mo'i gnad bskul
